groups.native-raw-storage: InstancePage/GlobalInstanceAllocator and BatchBuffer expose public native primitive fields. BatchData correlates indirect/uniform/metadata per index, not a sealed application domain product; external public mutation/reset can violate correlated lengths. Keep canonical first-party counts/identities/geometry until actual native records, no claim that dependency public fields confer application admission.
groups.native-gpu-order: PagePrepareRunner updates instance source/output, then batches, writes noncompute output, flushes triple batch buffers, then updates bind groups/capacity. Thus normal runner constructs referenced buffers before conditional unwrap; raw standalone InstancePage.update with source+metadata but no output/indirect can panic. Native contract not a global reason to patch third-party source or duplicate wrappers everywhere. Native update methods write GPU before whole frame ends; no transactional rollback contract inferred.
groups.native-batch-coherence: Batcher obtains mesh and batch ID before one BatchData install, updates all three arrays through same index. Missing mesh/input skipped, allocation missing source offset defaults0 (native behavior not evidence valid first-party allocation absence). ensure_capacity resizes together; native raw public fields can break it. BatchBuffer.reset clears vec lengths but retains recorded capacity; subsequent direct small update may index empty vector. No current application reset path or observed bug established; Native05 still tracing actual callers. Original REG015 label tests228+ corrected: actual228-230 macro instantiations, tests232+ excluded.
groups.admitted-native-quantities: Instance allocation pageusize/offsetu32, batchIDu32, metadata start/end row wire shape; actual framework buffer size/layout and GPU counters are valid extraction ports. Vec counts casts and offset+length require upstream capacity admission; raw enum/struct definitions do not prove it. GPU buffer capacity alignment and native immutable size handling differ from semantic units. prepare Core BatchInput instance Arc and main/render entity identities remain separate representations, not interchangeable IDs.
groups.limits: Only exact direct constructors/storage/updater/flush used by registered first-party custom shader pipeline; no entire dependency/package waiver or unrelated BatchKey role. No tests/source edits/project execution; actual native admission review does not credit Root04 or Native05 automatically.
